fields.label: Service
fields.description: Suggests addresses as an address is typed: in Address forms, and in a store's address forms when Shop is installed.

fields.label: Photon Server
fields.description: Free worldwide addresses from OpenStreetMap. Leave empty for komoot's public server (https://photon.komoot.io), which asks for fair use and promises no uptime, or enter your own Photon server.

fields.label: Google API Key
fields.description: A Google Cloud key with Places API (New). Google gives 10,000 lookups a month free, then charges per lookup.

fields.label: Daily Lookup Limit
fields.description: The most requests sent to Google in a day, so no one can run up a bill. Google's 10,000 free a month is about 330 a day. 0 for no limit.

fields.options: Suggestions are asked for from this site, so the key is never sent to browsers.
